description: This Kotlin source file defines an Android home screen widget called CalendarWidget, which displays the current date and a list of calendar events. It manages widget updates, user interaction, and preferences for showing date and events.

classes.name: CalendarWidget
classes.description: An AppWidgetProvider subclass implementing a calendar widget showing date and events, handling updates and user interactions.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Called to update the widget's views, setting date and events display based on preferences.

methods.name: updateWidget
methods.description: Performs the update of widget views, including setting the date, configuring event list, and handling click actions.

methods.name: getShowDateKey
methods.description: Generates a preference key for storing whether to show the date, unique per widget ID.

methods.name: getShowEventsKey
methods.description: Generates a preference key for storing whether to show events, unique per widget ID.

methods.name: saveWidgetSettings
methods.description: Saves the widget's display settings for showing date and events into shared preferences.
